clauses.text:
1.1 'Confidential Information' means all technical, commercial, financial, proprietary, and legal data disclosed by either
Party.
1.2 'Effective Date' means 10th February 2025 unless formally extended by mutual written consent.

2.1 The Second Party shall perform the services, supply of materials, or operational duties in strict compliance with quality
standards applicable in Gujranwala, Punjab.
2.2 In consideration thereof, the agreed commercial value is PKR 22,000,000 for 1.5 MW Industrial Rooftop Solar
Installation, payable within fifteen (15) business days against an undisputed invoice under Pakistan taxation regulations.

3.1 Each Party represents that it is duly incorporated or legally qualified to enter into binding legal relations under the laws
of Pakistan.
3.2 Each Party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other against direct third-party claims arising from gross
negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of statutory obligations.

4.1 Except for indemnity breaches or intentional tort, neither Party shall be liable for indirect, punitive, or consequential
damages.
4.2 Maximum aggregate financial liability shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable during the preceding twelve (12)
calendar months.

5.1 This Agreement remains valid for an initial period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, terminable for
convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice.
5.2 Either Party may terminate immediately upon an uncured material default remaining after fourteen (14) days' written
cure notice. Force majeure events suspend performance for up to sixty (60) days.

6.1 This Agreement shall be governed by, construed, and enforced in accordance with NEPRA Act, 1997 and Contract
Act, 1872.
6.2 Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940 seated at
Gujranwala, Punjab, and the Lahore High Court shall have exclusive supervisory jurisdiction.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the authorized signatories execute this Agreement at Gujranwala, Punjab.
For Reon Industrial Solar Gujranwala: ______________________
For Ghauri Power Engineering Solutions: ______________________
In presence of Khan & Associates (Advocates & Legal Consultants)
